title: aria-graph-ipo-v1
description: Typed experience graph exported by the Aria telemetry transform. A projection of the engine's graph G, produced strictly outside the core loop (A5/L5). Embeddings are f64; reduced precision is view-only and never appears here.

edges.description: Typed directed edges. Every endpoint must be a node id present in `nodes` (Inv3: no dangling edges).

origin.description: Provenance discriminator. `input` was shaped from the host payload during Init. `transform` is a deterministic anchor Phi created (a Match-absorbed latent); it carries no prose and asserts no host fact.

binaryType.description: Host research-binary kind this element routes to. Resolved deterministically: host-supplied value, then a Custom label already containing a '.', then the fixed built-in table. Never inferred by a model.

id.description: Arena identity, unique within the envelope.

type.description: Wire name of the node type: observation, hypothesis, action, goal, invariant_checkpoint, or a Custom label.

embedding.description: Point of Z. Every component finite; all nodes share one dimension.

type.description: Wire name of the relation: causally_precedes, contradicts, refines, temporal_next, or a Custom label.
